plan.notes: Set to approved only after the user confirms the page-by-page outline.

designTermsState.notes: Approve after design intent, terminology boundary, and continuation state are established.

theme.notes: Choose theme and color semantics before the layout blueprint.

layoutBlueprint.notes: Required for decks over 8 pages or visually complex decks.

anchorSample.notes: Set to approved only after the user approves the anchor sample style.

productionMode.notes: Mode A=batch/chapter, Mode B=sequential full deck, Mode C=parallel chapter production.
